body:
## Summary
- **Ctrl+click** mixer meter cycles Peak ↔ K14 ballistics.
- Pk/K14 badge under meter; `read_meters` uses active `meter_type()`.
- Dummy `--smoke-meter-type` asserts Peak↔K14 and leaves Peak.

## Smoke
```
win_ardour\run-engine-shell-release.bat --backend Dummy --smoke-meter-type --timeout 25 --no-splash
```
exit 0.

## Policy
Modern D2D + thin Cairo; no gtkmm2; WASAPI shared. Independent of #82–#84 (Shift+click meter point stays on #82).
title: Cycle strip meter type Peak/K14
